  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := zmod5_cycle_has_same (fun j => c (j, g j))

let i_g (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : ZMod 5 := Classical.choose (h_eg g)
let eg (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : D := ⟨⟦((i_g g, g (i_g g)), (i_g g + 1, g (i_g g + 1)))⟧, Classical.choose_spec (h_eg g)⟩
have h_card_univ : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).card = n ^ 5 := by
  rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card 5, Fintype.card_fin]
have h_sum := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := eg) (t := Finset.univ) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
rw [h_card_univ] at h_sum
have h_fiber (d : D) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg g = d)).card ≤ n ^ 3 := by
  have hd_mem : (d : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) ∈ (blowupC5 n).edgeFinset := hD_sub d.2
  rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hd_mem
  obtain ⟨u, v⟩ := d.1
  have h_rel := hd_mem.2
  rcases h_rel with h1 | h2
  · obtain ⟨k, a⟩ := u
    obtain ⟨k', b⟩ := v
    dsimp at h1
    subst h1
    let inj_map (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n := (g (k + 2), g (k + 3), g (k + 4))
    have h_inj : Set.InjOn inj_map ↑((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg g = d)) := by
      intro g1 hg1 g2 hg2 h_eq
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hg1 hg2
      have hg1_eq : eg g1 = d := hg1.2
      have hg2_eq : eg g2 = d := hg2.2
      have h12 : (eg g1 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = (eg g2 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) := by rw [hg1_eq, hg2_eq]
      dsimp [eg] at h12
      rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at h12
      have h_cases (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) (hg_eq : (eg g : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧) :
          g k = a ∧ g (k + 1) = b := by
        dsimp [eg] at hg_eq
        rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at hg_eq
        rcases hg_eq with ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩
        · subst hk1; subst hk3
          exact ⟨hk2, hk4⟩
        · exfalso
          have : i_g g + 1 = i_g g + 2 := by rw [hk3, hk1]
          exact zmod5_two_ne_zero (by omega)
      have h_d_val : (d : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := rfl
      have hg1_val : (eg g1 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := by rw [hg1_eq, h_d_val]
      have hg2_val : (eg g2 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := by rw [hg2_eq, h_d_val]
      obtain ⟨hg1_k, hg1_k1⟩ := h_cases g1 hg1_val
      obtain ⟨hg2_k, hg2_k1⟩ := h_cases g2 hg2_val
      ext z
      fin_cases z - k <;>
      · have : z = k + (z - k) := by ring
        rw [this]
        dsimp [inj_map] at h_eq
        injection h_eq with h_eq1 h_eq23
        injection h_eq23 with h_eq2 h_eq3
        first | rw [hg1_k, hg2_k] | rw [hg1_k1, hg2_k1] | rw [h_eq1] | rw [h_eq2] | rw [h_eq3]
    have h_le := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn inj_map (by intro x _; exact Finset.mem_univ _) h_inj
    have h_prod : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n × Fin n)).card = n ^ 3 := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
      ring
    rwa [h_prod] at h_le
  · obtain ⟨k', b⟩ := u
    obtain ⟨k, a⟩ := v
    dsimp at h2
    subst h2
    have h_symm : (d : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := Quotient.sound (Or.inr rfl)
    let inj_map (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n := (g (k + 2), g (k + 3), g (k + 4))
    have h_inj : Set.InjOn inj_map ↑((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg g = d)) := by
      intro g1 hg1 g2 hg2 h_eq
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hg1 hg2
      have hg1_eq : eg g1 = d := hg1.2
      have hg2_eq : eg g2 = d := hg2.2
      have h_cases (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) (hg_eq : (eg g : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧) :
          g k = a ∧ g (k + 1) = b := by
        dsimp [eg] at hg_eq
        rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at hg_eq
        rcases hg_eq with ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩
        · subst hk1; subst hk3
          exact ⟨hk2, hk4⟩
        · exfalso
          have : i_g g + 1 = i_g g + 2 := by rw [hk3, hk1]
          exact zmod5_two_ne_zero (by omega)
      have hg1_val : (eg g1 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := by rw [hg1_eq, h_symm]
      have hg2_val : (eg g2 : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) = ⟦((k, a), (k + 1, b))⟧ := by rw [hg2_eq, h_symm]
      obtain ⟨hg1_k, hg1_k1⟩ := h_cases g1 hg1_val
      obtain ⟨hg2_k, hg2_k1⟩ := h_cases g2 hg2_val
      ext z
      fin_cases z - k <;>
      · have : z = k + (z - k) := by ring
        rw [this]
        dsimp [inj_map] at h_eq
        injection h_eq with h_eq1 h_eq23
        injection h_eq23 with h_eq2 h_eq3
        first | rw [hg1_k, hg2_k] | rw [hg1_k1, hg2_k1] | rw [h_eq1] | rw [h_eq2] | rw [h_eq3]
    have h_le := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn inj_map (by intro x _; exact Finset.mem_univ _) h_inj
    have h_prod : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n × Fin n)).card = n ^ 3 := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
      ring
    rwa [h_prod] at h_le
have h_bound : ∑ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset D),
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg g = d)).card ≤ D.card * n ^ 3 := by
  calc ∑ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset D), ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg g = d)).card
    _ ≤ ∑ _d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset D), n ^ 3 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_fiber d)
    _ = D.card * n ^ 3 := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, smul_eq_mul]
have h_final : n ^ 5 ≤ D.card * n ^ 3 := h_sum.trans h_bound
have h_n3_pos : 0 < n ^ 3 := Nat.pow_pos _hn
have h_mul : n ^ 2 * n ^ 3 = n ^ 5 := by ring
rw [← h_mul] at h_final
exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_final h_n3_pos
